controls: two disconnected-by-void load-carrying vertical strips, each minimally restrained
F1.island_policy: No removal/filling/weak springs; audit edge and node connectivity. Only unloaded floating islands may be explicitly minimally grounded as a separately documented physical assumption; otherwise HOLD that configuration.
F1.refinement: H1 and H2 reference and selected generated source if mechanical connectivity qualifies

H2_selection: First two final heldout seeds of every initial and revised script, feasible only; no substitutions or favorable expansion

STL.exact: Preserve XY pixel support; explicitly diagnose point-only connections and small details
STL.geometry: Single coherent height-field boundary surface, no internal overlapped shells; independent STL re-import and edge/link/volume/intersection validation
STL.interpretation: Enlarged educational relief, arbitrary presentation XY/Z scale, no genuine3D reconstruction or mechanical specimen
STL.print_ready: If needed, registered 3x3 square binary opening then closing within field; retain source unchanged, quantify every changed pixel/region and preserve small-feature diagnostics. No outcome-based aesthetic redraw.
STL.slicer: Search installed supported slicers and slice if available; otherwise mark NOT_VERIFIED; no actual printer assumed

arm_comparison: Mean independent NF final-script error minus mean independent IF final-script error; positive favors IF. Also compare per-conversation error reductions. Missing/invalid scores null, never zero.

directional_extension.horizontal: Rotate unchanged source by90degrees, identical evaluator, H1; transformed-domain x loading and free transverse displacement. Record phase/source maps; not a homogenized tensor.

element.integration: 2x2, full integration B-bar; no uniform reduced integration/hourglass control
element.name: PLANE182

generator_failure_policy: Bounded explicit failure preserved; evaluator never repairs or substitutes seeds
heldout_policy: No final generation before all16 authentic initial/revised modules plus prompts/protocol collectively frozen; no final seeds/results reach any model
human_submission_gate: If actual UI unavailable, preserve exact chat URL and next same-chat message; still complete required F1 and STL
initial_prompt_images: Authenticated raw P3 microscopy input; segmentation mask remains evaluator-only. Common source/structural descriptions may be supplied identically.
initial_variation: Identical prompt/reference/common source template, but actual independent initial responses may differ. Do not claim common-source paired design.
loading: UYbottom0, UYtop=-strain*H, UXbottomleft0; other UX free; sides traction free

material.interface: perfectly bonded shared nodes, no contact

model_policy: Ordinary persistent ChatGPT chats, one initial and one continuation in each original URL; exposed model/reasoning consistent, backend/personalization limitations recorded
morphology_policy: Byte-identical v073 numerical envelope; cohort all-valid criterion adapted to six final seeds without changing per-array thresholds
native_route: Five actual native solved checkpoints and independent RST reopening for every accepted model
primary_metric: Per-script mean absolute relative target error, conditional on feasibility with full attempted denominators; 6/6 required for full generator qualification
target_selection: User-specified prospective target supported by authenticated v073 horizontal-family measurements; no old two-SD gate reapplied
